levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الاشعري
أبي الحسن عيسى بن محمد بن عيسى بن عبد الله المحمدي

notes: «12-1» is the report number; «من ولد محمد بن الحنفية» is a lineage descriptor, not part of the surface.
«أبي» (the compiler's father, bare) is a relation (rule 7).

Needs a ruling: the scene (Jews question Umar; the answers are given by Ali inside the narration, «فقال لهم علي عليه السلام») is a narrated encounter where the Imam speaks (rule 11). Tawus is left as the last link of the chain as written.
